page.title: Loans
page.emptyDescription: Add a new loan or track an existing balance over its remaining term. Enter the schedule manually and check it against your lender’s records.
page.newDescription: Start a new loan or track an existing one
page.detailDescription: Repayment schedule, payment history and prepayment simulator

summary.debtDescription: Outstanding loans, credit card debt and overdrafts in your household’s base currency.
summary.netAssetsDescription: Positive account balances minus liabilities, using today’s exchange rates. Credit limits are excluded from assets.
summary.interestTotal: Interest since tracking began: {amount} (paid + future interest)

wizard.invalid: Enter a name, lender, account and valid amounts
wizard.invalidDates: Check the loan start date and tracking date
wizard.calculationHint: Insurance and fees are excluded. Check the breakdown with your lender. For daily interest methods, the annuity uses r/12 and the final payment is adjusted for actual days.
wizard.name: Name
wizard.originalHint: If unknown, we use the current balance. Interest paid before tracking began is excluded.
wizard.shortMonth: Uses the last day in shorter months.
wizard.termHint: The remaining term is estimated using the monthly rate. See the result in the preview.
wizard.ledgerHint: The opening debt is recorded in a separate liability account. Loan proceeds and purchases are not created automatically. Stop any existing recurring expenses for this loan to avoid duplicate payments.
wizard.previewAmounts: First payment: {first}. Interest over the remaining term: {interest}.
wizard.currencyHint: The loan uses {currency}, the payment account’s currency.

detail.closeDescription: You can close the loan after repaying the principal and interest. Posted payments and the account remain in your history.
detail.deleteDescription: Only loans without posted payments can be deleted. The loan, opening debt and planned payments will be removed.
detail.terms: {lender} · rate {rate}% · payoff {payoff} · {status, select, active {active} other {closed}}. Tracking since {trackingDate}.

event.prepaymentHint: This records an actual principal repayment from the payment account. Confirm earlier payments first. Interest accrued up to this date stays in the next payment.
event.reconcileHint: Enter only the principal balance from your lender. Earlier unconfirmed payments will be reconciled. The difference adjusts the debt without creating income or expenses.
event.rateHint: The new rate applies after the selected date and future plans are recalculated. The date can be in the future, such as a rate change agreed in the contract.
event.prepaymentDescription: Prepayment {amount} · {mode, select, reduce_term {shorten term} other {lower payment}}
event.holidayDescription: {mode, select, no_payment {Payment holiday} other {Interest-only holiday}} until {end}
event.cancelDescription: The schedule returns to the terms before this change. Payments it closed or removed become planned again.

simulator.title: Prepayment simulator
simulator.description: Compare scenarios using existing loan events. Nothing is saved. Future payments are assumed to follow the schedule.

confirm.invalid: Check the payment amount and breakdown
confirm.title: Confirm loan payment
confirm.hint: Both parts are confirmed together. Changing the principal recalculates the future schedule while keeping the payment amount.

terms.endHint: The last scheduled payment on or before this date.
terms.calculatePaymentHint: The payment is calculated from the term and the balance.
terms.calculateTermHint: The term is calculated from the payment and the balance.
terms.calculateBothHint: Set the payment and term by hand, as in the contract. The last payment settles the balance.

edit.title: Edit loan
edit.description: The name, lender and account change right away. New terms recalculate future payments, and the preview shows the result before you save.
edit.hintHistory: Confirmed payments and past events stay as they are. New terms apply after {date}, and the previous ones remain in the history.
edit.hintFresh: There are no payments or events yet, so the schedule is recalculated from the tracking start.
edit.locked: The tracking start is fixed by history: {date}, balance {amount}. To correct the debt, reconcile the balance or restructure the loan.

restructure.title: Restructure loan
restructure.description: New contract terms from the selected date. The schedule is rebuilt from that date, while prior terms and confirmed payments stay in the history.
restructure.balanceHint: Use the amount from the new contract, including any interest added to the debt. The difference changes the debt without income or an expense.
restructure.balanceAhead: This date is still ahead, so the debt comes from the schedule. You can set a different one once the date arrives.
restructure.unpaid: {count, plural, one {# unconfirmed payment} other {# unconfirmed payments}} before this date will be closed, replaced by the new schedule.

holiday.title: Payment holiday
holiday.description: A period with no payments or with interest only. Payments due within the period are not collected.
holiday.mode: What to pay during this period
holiday.interest: What happens to interest for the period

interestOption.deferred_end: Paid at the end of the schedule

interestHint.deferred_end: Interest accumulates separately and earns no further interest. Payments resume as before, and the accumulated amount is paid at the end.
interestHint.deferred_spread: Interest accumulates separately and earns no further interest. The accumulated amount is added in equal parts to the remaining payments.
interestHint.capitalize: On the last day of the holiday, interest is added to the debt and starts earning interest itself. The payment is recalculated.
interestHint.waived: No interest is charged for the period. Interest accrued before the holiday is included in the first payment after it.

holiday.shiftExtendHint: Remaining payments move by the length of the holiday, and the end date comes later.
holiday.shiftKeepHint: The end date stays and the remaining payments rise. Interest deferred to the end is included in the last payment.
holiday.skipped: Not collected: {count, plural, one {# payment} other {# payments}}, from {from} to {to}.
holiday.interestOnlySlots: Interest only: {count, plural, one {# payment} other {# payments}}, from {from} to {to}.
holiday.endHint: To end the holiday early, pick a new date no earlier than today ({date}). Payments after it return to the schedule.
